g.text: All 20 source histories continued under four actual interventions
Each thin line is one source state; every branch has the same two fresh cases. Context removal is a bundle, including prior financial feedback; own cumulative score and auditor history remain.
Descriptive matched continuations: no new p-values or confidence intervals. Fines are separate from payment loss. A live receipt cap does not establish cessation of agreement or attempts.
